arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: General Dynamics and Boeing argue that suing contractors waives immunity.
The government argues that suing contractors does not waive immunity.
Justice Sotomayor asked why the contract did not require sharing technology.
Justice Ginsburg asked why contractors did not mention cost issues earlier.
